thread_text:
Tess Nguyen: Hi everyone — Tess here, started on Eng-Platform today! 👋 Quick heads-up: I'm still waiting on MDM and VPN access. Also, who should I ping for a repo + SSH key setup? Also for fun — two truths and a lie about me: 1) I once brewed kombucha in a backyard shed, 2) I can solve a Rubik's cube in under 2 minutes, 3) I have a pet iguana named Pickles. Guess which is the lie?

Devon Park: Welcome Tess!! 🎉 I'm your manager — Devon. I'll loop in IT and your buddy. For SSH/repo access ping @Asha and @Samir. Also lunch on Friday? :)

Asha Patel: Hey Tess — added. Quick questions: did you receive the enrollment email for Jamf MDM? If not, check spam then DM me. For VPN, are you on mac or windows?

Tess Nguyen: macbook — yes I got a laptop delivered but the Jamf email didn't show up. Spam checked. No access to internal wiki either.

Marta (IT): Hi Tess, Marta from IT. I can re-send the enrollment link and manually approve your device. Can you paste the serial number? (or DM me if you'd rather).

Samir Rao: I'm your onboarding buddy — Samir. I can help with repo access and SSH config. Quickest flow: generate an SSH key, drop the pub in the onboarding form, and I'll add you to the team org. Example command if you need it:

Samir Rao: ```
ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "tess.nguyen@redwood.com"
cat ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub
```

Tess Nguyen: Thanks Samir — will run that in a bit. Also curious about stickers — who still has the vintage redwood stickers? 😄

Liam - design: Stickers are in the office sticker bin. If you're remote we can mail some. DM shipping addr to @Marta. Also welcome!

Devon Park: For internal channels, here's the short list: #eng-platform, #eng-runtime, #oncall-rotations, #new-hires. I'll invite you to #eng-platform now.

Tess Nguyen: Got invited to #eng-platform, thanks! 

HR Bot: Reminder — complete the benefits enrollment by EOD Friday to avoid delays. Link: https://intranet.redwood/benefits

Tess Nguyen: Quick update: I sent my device serial to Marta and submitted the SSH pub key. Thanks for the samples and the warm welcome everyone. Also, which was my lie? (trying to keep suspense)

Samir Rao: I'd bet the iguana is the lie but can't be sure. 😄

Devon Park: My guess is kombucha in a shed is true, Rubik's cube under 2 minutes is true, pickles the iguana is the lie. Either way, we'll find out at the team lunch. Welcome again! :party_parrot:

Tess Nguyen: You got it — the iguana is the lie. I do have a sourdough starter and a decent cubing time tho. Thanks for the fast responses, y'all. Excited to be here! :rocket:
